## Experiment or shared change

- Experiment ID and owner, or shared-change topic
- Parent branch/commit and linked experiment folder
- Question and reason for the change

## Changes and preserved settings

- Changed factors and relevant code paths
- Full configuration and scoring/tie/eligibility contract

## Validation and results

- Separate code review, fixes and appropriate checks for each code iteration
- Run folders and canonical result manifests
- Exact source commit, input/binary hashes and correctness evidence
- Failed, negative or incomplete attempts and their interpretation
- Measurement boundary, uncertainty and validation limits

## Decision and next work

- Conclusion supported by the saved evidence
- Merge/integration implications and next experiment

## Before review

- [ ] Work is on the appropriate experiment or shared-change branch.
- [ ] Experiment README, full config, code paths and run links are current.
- [ ] Raw results and logs have a canonical results folder with artifact hashes.
- [ ] Recording IDs and qualification are included.
- [ ] Sensitive files and bulk data have been excluded from the public commit.
- [ ] No agent signature or co-author trailer was added.
